subject: general
question:
Select the number from among the given alternatives that can replace the question mark (?) in the last figure.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f19b818df671784c0a74548928e3f196a5085596dce5058e4feb39eda54c073d.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fb510c2dc844472ce22cd55d78a4ff783a6d62e6beab00a8ee719fee0d55e910.png] ⇒3² + 5² + 2² = 9 + 25 + 4 → 38

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/46124e37e11a82156ae62e6353922b8f8b69ddb5a5f44b898272409126479990.png] ⇒42 + 52 + 12 = 16 + 25 + 1 → 42

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/30ac2d99e0eb624c70ebd71774f63b3afe49a8bf5cd8effe2ec7d1aaad9cd8a6.png] ⇒62 + 72 + 22 = 36 + 49 + 4 → 89

Similarly,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c1d32e5d5b9a68bad52e36315703d5f7fd3a43231b4df7f0d8455703083b14eb.png] ⇒32 + 42 + 72 = 9 + 16 + 49 →** 74**

Hence, **"Option 2"** is the correct answer.
